cleansingStrength.rationale: `moderate` by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 (ether/sulfonate type), three prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3 amphoteric, Decyl Glucoside@4 and Coco-Glucoside@5 nonionic glucosides), no reinforcing strong anionic. Counter-signals (refatting Glyceryl Oleate@11, Dicaprylyl Ether@10) argue lower but never move a C1 value; the triple buffer makes the convention unambiguous.

conditioningLevel.rationale: `high` by C2: prominent payload_lipid Dicaprylyl Ether@10 and Hydrogenated Castor Oil@14 take the place of the early silicone; cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@9; pearlizing/fatty route Glycol Distearate@13; deliberate humectant Glycerin@12 (R11 list). Also W-RICH for conditioning (E3-prominent payload lipid with a cationic system). Confidence moderate: every route sits in the second half of the list (after Citric Acid@7 and Aloe@8), the lipids are a light emollient ether and a small waxy thickener-type lipid, so realistic dose unknowns could leave one bounded system (`moderate`).

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate — one cationic guar plus two material lipids (light emollient ether, small waxy lipid) and a glyceride refatter; no silicone.
weightPotential.persistence: moderate — guar can deposit via coacervate; Dicaprylyl Ether is light and spreading, HCO is waxy but at the W-line boundary; no persistent silicone system.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate — C1 ether-sulfate chassis with three buffers (effective ordinary reset, not limited).
weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH is established for weight (material Dicaprylyl Ether@10/HCO@14 converging with guar@9), which argues for `high`; but W-RICH needs limited reset and reset is moderate.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Interacting light/moderate routes (guar + material lipids + refatter) plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue; an ordinary buffered sulfate reset argues against a coating result.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not `high`: W-RICH holds but resetCapacity is moderate (not limited), and the remaining convergence (one guar + a light ether and a boundary-position waxy lipid, no silicone) is not plausibly persistent enough to outrun an ordinary C1 reset. Not `low`: two deposition families with material lipids (W2) make 'lightweight' an understatement.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-RICH counter-signal with HCO at W-line-1; dose of guar and lipids unknown (INCI order only).
weightPotential.rationale: `moderate`: W-RICH present but reset not limited (W-RICH limited-reset clause), convergence not strong enough for the high anchor; W2 rules out low. Neighbor `high` (W-RICH recorded as counter-signal).
